title: Book Three · Chapter 5: A Place at Lunch
story:
The next day, Anna closes her lunch box early.

“I am meeting a friend downstairs,” she says.

“For a run?”

“No. We went to the same school before. She wants to tell me about her new class.”

Anna takes her water bottle and leaves. Ronan still has half his lunch.

He eats a piece of carrot. At the next desk, two boys are arguing about a ball.

“It hit the line,” one says.

“Your shoe hit the line.”

“My shoe was on my foot.”

“That is usually the place for it.”

Ronan laughs. Both boys turn.

“You saw it?” the first boy asks.

“No. I heard the part about your shoe.”

The second boy laughs too. He is the boy with the ball from the first morning. Today the ball is under his chair.

“We need another player,” he says. “Can you come?”

Ronan looks at his lunch.

“In a minute.”

“We will be near the wall.”

The boys take their boxes away. Ronan finishes his rice, closes his box, and goes downstairs.

Four boys stand in a rough circle. Ronan stops a few steps away.

The boy with the ball waves him over.

“Here. You stand here.”

He throws the ball gently. Ronan catches it against his chest.

“Now to him.”

Ronan turns and throws. The ball goes too high. The next boy reaches up, but it passes his hands.

It hits the wall and comes back.

“The wall can play too,” someone says.

Ronan runs after the ball. He picks it up near a tree and brings it back.

“Does the wall need lunch?” he asks.

“No. It eats bad throws.”

This time, Ronan looks at the other boy's hands. He throws lower. The boy catches it.

The ball moves around the circle. Sometimes a boy drops it. Sometimes two boys reach for the same throw. No one keeps a score.

After a while, Ronan calls for the ball. His voice surprises him a little.

It comes straight toward him. He catches it, steps back, and sends it across the circle.

Anna walks past with another girl. They are talking quickly. Anna lifts her hand. Ronan lifts his, and the next ball strikes his arm.

“You need that hand,” the boy beside him says.

“I noticed.”

They play until the bell.

Upstairs, Anna is already at the desk. She moves her bottle away from his book.

“Good lunch?” she asks.

“Yes. The wall played badly.”

She looks at him.

“You need to tell me that story.”

He starts to explain. Then the teacher puts a book on the front desk.

“Later,” Anna whispers.

Ronan nods. There is a pale mark on his sleeve. He brushes it with his hand and opens his book.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

argue＝争论；player＝参加球赛的人；circle＝圆圈；score＝得分。

## 理解问题

1. Anna这天午饭后去见谁？她是不是去跑步？
2. Ronan第一次传球发生了什么？后来他怎样调整？

## 读句子

**He throws the ball gently.**

拆开看：He / throws the ball / gently.

他／把球抛过来／轻轻地。
